description: This file defines the ScheduledPost struct and related methods for handling scheduled posts in Mattermost, including validation, conversion to posts, and error handling.

classes.name: ScheduledPost
classes.description: Represents a scheduled post with validation, conversion, and auditing methods.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the scheduled post, including draft validation and scheduled time constraints.

methods.name: BaseIsValid
methods.description: Performs base validation checks on the scheduled post fields.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the scheduled post for saving by initializing ID and timestamps.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates timestamps before updating the scheduled post.

methods.name: ToPost
methods.description: Converts a scheduled post into a regular Mattermost post object.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the scheduled post's audit information.

methods.name: RestoreNonUpdatableFields
methods.description: Restores fields that should not be updated from an original scheduled post.

methods.name: SanitizeInput
methods.description: Sanitizes input fields, clearing creation time and embedded metadata.

methods.name: GetPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the priority information from the post metadata.
